notes: Each segment is a quintic rest-to-rest curve: s(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5.
Dynamics use the original MuJoCo position actuators plus qfrc_bias/kp control bias compensation.
Plant meshes remain display-only. Full triangle geometry is checked externally on every reference and simulated state.
Hard checks use conservative robot bounding spheres. Soft scores are conservative geometric exposure, not measured force or plant damage.
The final hold is a one-second preview pause, not an actual watering flow command.
